title: What The Bass Guitar Knows — EN/ES/IT (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy Spanish Italian language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The bass guitar is the instrument nobody notices is there
Until it isn't — and then the whole song seems to disappear
Into a collection of sounds that don't add up to a room
The bass guitar holds the bottom and the bottom holds the boom

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El bajo eléctrico es el instrumento que nadie nota que está
[The bass guitar is the instrument nobody notices is there]
Hasta que no está — y entonces la canción se va
[Until it isn't — and then the song disappears]
En una colección de sonidos que no suman una habitación
[Into a collection of sounds that don't add up to a room]
El bajo sostiene el fondo — el fondo sostiene la canción
[The bass holds the bottom — the bottom holds the song]

[Chorus — English]
What does the bass guitar know that I don't know?
It knows the bottom of the song is what keeps the top in flow
What does the bass guitar know from the back of the stage?
It knows that holding things together is the most underpaid wage
That's my boy

[Bridge — Italian, with English translation]
Il basso elettrico è lo strumento che nessuno nota che c'è
[The bass guitar is the instrument nobody notices is there]
Finché non sparisce — e allora tutto crolla per sé
[Until it disappears — and then everything collapses on its own]
Il basso tiene il fondo e il fondo tiene il suono
[The bass holds the bottom and the bottom holds the sound]
Il bassista sa che tenere insieme è il lavoro più buono
[The bassist knows that holding together is the best work]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the bass guitar knows… Lo que sabe el bajo… Quello che sa il basso
The bottom holds the top — El fondo sostiene lo alto — Il fondo sostiene il tutto
That's my boy
